Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.security

Class FilterChainEntry

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.security.FilterChainEntry
public class FilterChainEntry extends Object
DTO for a GeoServer security filter chain entry. Maps GET/POST/PUT /rest/security/filterchain.

Fields use @-prefixed JSON keys (XStream convention). The filters field may contain either one value or a list; ACCEPT_SINGLE_VALUE_AS_ARRAY handles both cases transparently.
